name: tracer-slice
description: Build one TRACER slice test-first on the final architecture, then verify it blind as its audience would: its critical flows' CORRECT lines, the component floors and the anti-pattern catalogue; fix only what is confirmed. For repositories with a docs/tracer/ folder

steps.title: Build the slice, test-first
Verify it as its audience would
steps.prompt:
Verify, without changing any file, the TRACER slice built for: {slice}

You are the verifier, not the builder: work from docs/tracer/ (the audience profile, the critical flows, floors.md, anti-patterns.md, identity.md) and the diff named below, never from the builder's account. For every critical flow the change reaches, follow its success path and every failure path (through the interface when a browser capability is given, else by reading the code and the tests that drive it) and check each CORRECT line; check every component on its screens against its floor, the rendered text for ids, storage keys, paths and stack traces, and every entry of the anti-pattern catalogue. Report each line that does not hold in `findings`: its place, what the person would see, how it is known (`deterministic` with the step, test or rendered text as `proof`, else `inferential`) and whether this change caused it. Something wrong that no spec, floor or catalogue entry covers is an escaped expectation: say so, and the CORRECT line or catalogue entry it calls for.

steps.title: Decide what the verification only read
steps.prompt: Decide, without changing any file, the findings on the TRACER slice for: {slice}

steps.title: Fix the confirmed findings
steps.prompt:
Fix the confirmed findings below, in the TRACER slice for: {slice}

A finding that is an escaped expectation also adds its CORRECT line to the flow's spec in docs/tracer/flows/ and its entry to docs/tracer/floors.md or docs/tracer/anti-patterns.md, so it cannot escape again. Run the tests before you stop.

steps.title: Check each fix
steps.prompt: Check, without changing any file, the fix just made in the TRACER slice for: {slice}
